// tests `error_string` above
#[test]
fn ntstatus_error() {

    assert!(
        !Error::from_raw_os_error((STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL | c::FACILITY_NT_BIT) as _)
            .to_string()
            .contains("FormatMessageW() returned error")
